title: Staccato's Minerals [ALPHA]
description: Mod is in early Alpha state and currently adds Amber as a new furnace fuel and material to craft torches out of and Tungsten as a material (currently does nothing) to be found as a deepslate ore
body:
![Title Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/550cd19f3cb3029d92680f4ae6e0b80e9de4bb1c.png)

# What is "Staccato's Minerals"?

  That is relatively simple ... it's just my first ever mod that is centered around:
  **Minerals!**


  With this mod my goal is to add features to Minecraft that I feel like should already be in
  the game like more Terracotta variants and more reasons to do some archeology.

  **The mod currently features:**
  - Amber: A new furnace fuel and material to craft into torches (can be found in the overworld
           as well as in the Nether)
  - Tungsten: As a Deepslate Ore along with Ingots, Pieces (Nuggets), Raw Tungsten, Tungsten
              Rod and Tungsten Shears (not functional yet)

  
  **What I want the Mod to be (aka what I am working on):**
  - Adding a Tungsten tool and armor set
  - Making Amber a Trim Material that will add a certain effect when used on an armor
  - Adding minerals that serve as a base to adding more Trim Materials and therefore more
    effects
  - Adding a crafting station to craft the "normal" minerals into pure variants which are
    needed for the effects
  - Adding a totem/amulet system that uses the minerals as a "catalyst" for effects
  - Adding Tungsten as a material for tools and an important material for Totem crafting (like 
    a better brush, some better shears)
  - Adding various different decorational blocks and block variants (things like more terracotta variants, etc)

**DISCLAIMER**

With all that said, please keep in mind that this is my first ever experience with modding Minecraft, so things may take a while to be added or may completely be changed as I am still getting familiar with how everything works.

Please Note: currently the project is licensed as "All Rights Reserved" this is because this project is still in its Alpha phase and therefore things might change a lot. In the future when there is an actual release the licensing will definitely change.
